item.text:
Verdict: yes, with a major caveat. Putin’s 2024 system did turn many declarations into observable state action, but the implementation was skewed toward war mobilization, coercive control, and selective service delivery rather than broad, transparent, accountable governance.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level note | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Sets official goals for 2030 and 2036](https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986) | President of Russia | 2024-05-07 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986 | Putin’s program was not left as rhetoric: the decree ordered a unified plan, a spatial-development strategy, priority annual budget allocations, and monitoring by the Presidential Executive Office and State Council. | 8B.6; also 8B.3 |
| Positive | [Amendments to military statutes](https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print) | Kremlin | 2024-03-01 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print | The Kremlin converted discipline talk into concrete rules: commanders had to prevent crimes and incidents, report problems, react to storage alarms, and specify response actions for nuclear, chemical, and biological attacks. | 8B.6; also 8B.5 |
| Positive | [Putin taps civilian economist to run defence](https://theprint.in/world/putin-taps-civilian-economist-to-run-defence/2081878/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-13 | https://theprint.in/world/putin-taps-civilian-economist-to-run-defence/2081878/ | Replacing Shoigu with Belousov was a real personnel move aimed at better use of defence spending and more innovation, not just symbolic reshuffling. | 8B.6; also 8B.4, 8B.5 |
| Positive | [Putin clears out deputy defence ministers](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-clears-out-deputy-defence-ministers-appoints-his-relative-3486871) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-17 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-clears-out-deputy-defence-ministers-appoints-his-relative-3486871 | Putin removed four deputy defence ministers and replaced them, showing active enforcement and operational follow-through inside a critical ministry. | 8B.6; also 8B.5, 8B.4 |
| Positive | [Army to grow by 180,000 soldiers](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-orders-russian-army-to-grow-by-180000-soldiers-to-become-15-millionstrong-3617373) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-orders-russian-army-to-grow-by-180000-soldiers-to-become-15-millionstrong-3617373 | The army expansion is direct observable implementation: Putin translated war goals into manpower orders and administrative mobilization. | 8B.6; also 8B.3, 8B.5 |
| Positive | [Zemsky Doctor and Zemsky Paramedic extended to 2030](https://government.ru/docs/53769/) | Government of Russia | 2024-12-18 | https://government.ru/docs/53769/ | The state did not just talk about rural staffing; it extended the program, raised compensation, allowed transfers, and reported about 2,000 specialists recruited in 2024. | 8B.6; also 8B.5, 8B.4 |
| Positive | [AI strategy amendment](https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50326/print) | Kremlin | 2024-02-15 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50326/print | The amended AI strategy imposed concrete implementation duties on state-linked firms and civil servants, including plan updates, datasets, networks, and training. | 8B.6; also 8B.5, 8B.4 |
| Positive | [Biometric and platform-control law](https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/74828) | President of Russia | 2024-08-08 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/74828 | Putin converted information-control declarations into enforceable rules: user data disclosure, registration of large accounts, biometric verification, and SIM restrictions for foreigners. | 8B.6; also 8B.5, 8B.4 |
| Positive | [Central bank kept rates on hold after Putin’s call for balance](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin did not simply ignore the technocrats; he publicly backed tight policy while the central bank held rates, which is weak but real evidence of implementation through an expert institution. | 8B.6; also 8B.4, 8B.5 |
| Mixed | [Russia’s economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | Reuters reported broad growth and low unemployment, but said much of the expansion came from military production. That is observable implementation, but it is war-skewed and not a clean civilian delivery story. | 8B.6; also 8B.3 |
| Negative | [Moscow shooting poses awkward questions for Russia’s intelligence agencies](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/moscow-shooting-poses-awkward-questions-for-russias-intelligence-agencies-3352104) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/moscow-shooting-poses-awkward-questions-for-russias-intelligence-agencies-3352104 | Reuters said the security state was good at detaining opponents but failed to stop the Crocus attack, which is a concrete execution failure despite strong coercive capacity. | 8B.6; also 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures](https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001) | Reuters | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Reducing disclosure makes execution harder to verify and weakens the feedback loop needed for implementation discipline. | 8B.6; also 8B.5 |
| Negative | [Russia prepares for further tax rises due to war](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html) | Ukrinform / Reuters | 2024-11-02 | https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html | Reuters reporting said war financing was forcing tax rises and cuts in small-business support and education development, showing that implementation existed but was crowding out other goals. | 8B.6; also 8B.3 |
| Negative | [Freedom House: Russia](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Freedom House says local autonomy was weak, municipalities lacked financial independence, and decisions were made by a small closed circle. That undercuts any claim of broad institutionalized follow-through. | 8B.6; also 8B.5 |

Search gap: I found strong evidence of concrete implementation in security, coercion, budgets, and a few service programs, but not a single independent whole-of-government implementation audit. The remaining uncertainty is mainly about how far those decrees and orders translated into durable civilian outcomes outside the war and security sectors.
